title: "21_DataProcessing"
output: html_document

## Load the cleaned data

We load the packages and the cleaned data set `anes_cleaned`, which was saved at the end of `11_DataCleaning.Rmd`.

```{r load}
source("00_requirements.R")
load("12_cleanedElectionData.RData")
```

## Set the order of the categorical variables

`social_class`, `gender` and `party_id` are stored as character variables after cleaning. We convert them to factors with a fixed order of levels, so that every plot and table lists the categories in a meaningful order (for example, from lower class to upper class) instead of alphabetical order. `race` and `education_level` were already converted to ordered factors during cleaning.

```{r factors}
anes_processed <- anes_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    social_class = factor(social_class,
                          levels = c("Lower Class", "Working Class",
                                     "Middle Class", "Upper Class")),
    gender = factor(gender,
                    levels = c("Man", "Woman", "Nonbinary", "Other")),
    party_id = factor(party_id,
                      levels = c("Democrat", "Independent/None",
                                 "Republican", "Other"))
  )
```

## Create age groups

Age is a numeric variable. To compare vote choice across stages of life, we also group age into four categories: 18-29, 30-44, 45-59 and 60 and older. Respondents with a missing age get a missing age group.

```{r age-group}
anes_processed <- anes_processed %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(age,
                         breaks = c(17, 29, 44, 59, Inf),
                         labels = c("18-29", "30-44", "45-59", "60+")))

# check the new variable: number of respondents in each age group
anes_processed %>% count(age_group)
```

## Check the processed data

We check that the processed data has the same number of respondents as the cleaned data and that the new factor levels are in the intended order.

```{r check}
nrow(anes_processed)
str(anes_processed)
```

## Save the processed data

The processed data set is saved so that `31_DataVisualization.Rmd` and `FinalReport.Rmd` can load it directly.

```{r save}
save(anes_processed, file = "22_processedElectionData.RData")
```
